scripts.comment: 7.1.2.3: The base case is MOVE (SIZE) STEPS MOVE ((-1) × (SIZE)) STEPS which is the same as the body of TREE 1. The recursive case is MOVE (SIZE) STEPS TURN ↺ 25 DEGREES TREE, LEVEL: (LEVEL − 1) SIZE: (SIZE × 0.65) TURN ↻ 25 DEGREES TURN ↻ 35 DEGREES TREE, LEVEL: (LEVEL − 1) SIZE: (SIZE × 0.85) TURN ↺ 35 DEGREES MOVE ((-1) × (SIZE)) STEPS which is the same as the body of TREE 2 and up, except with recursive calls instead of calls to the specifically numbered blocks.
